name: elementalist_adept_prowess_triggers_on_a_noncreature_spell_only
notes: Printed: 'Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)' The Adept (2/1) is on your battlefield. You cast Quick Study (an instant): it becomes 3/2. You then cast Diregraf Ghoul (a creature spell): no trigger, it stays 3/2.
